Maya (CS): Heads up — AcmeCo renewal target 2026-04-10. Procurement flagged a vendor code mismatch and they're asking for a 6mo term instead of 12. Need to align billing entity + PO before sending e-sign.

Jamal (AM): Got it. Who owns vendor code reconciliation? @Priya?

Priya (Billing): I can look. Their PO shows vendor_code: 3948 but our ledger has 3498 — looks transposed. If they want 6mo, pricing will need a minor adjustment. Also confirm seat count.

Ben (Customer): Confirm seats = 12 active, likely +2 in Q3. Finance prefers net30, can sign 6mo if necessary.

Maya (CS): Thanks Ben. Main risk is billing entity — they sent EMEA PO but tax id missing. @Kathryn any standard amendment for entity swap + short term?

Kathryn (Legal): Yes — we have a short-term amendment template. Need official billing name + tax id. Quick checklist I'll use: 1) confirm vendor code matches PO 2) prepare 6mo amendment 3) update invoice entity 4) route DocuSign to delegated signer. I'll draft and share.

Jamal (AM): I'll ask Acme finance to reissue the PO with vendor_code=3498 and billing name 'AcmeCo EMEA' — pinging them now.

OnboardingBot: Reminder: add AcmeCo to renewal tracker -> status set to "awaiting PO".

Priya (Billing): Once we get corrected PO, finance can accept. If they add +2 seats, we'll pro-rate those months. Example calc: prorate = monthly_rate * (remaining_months/12) * seats_delta.

Maya (CS): Action items: Jamal to request reissued PO by EOD; Kathryn to prepare amendment (6mo + net30); Priya to confirm invoice routing after signed amendment; I'll schedule a 1hr enablement session next week for onboarding additional seats. Ben, we'll share the DocSend and PO link when ready.

Ben (Customer): Sounds good — please send DocSend link and I'll loop Finance.

Jamal (AM): Will post DocSend after Kathryn's draft is ready. ETA tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

Kathryn (Legal): Draft ready: https://docsend.com/abcd1234 — includes vendor code clause and billing entity section. Please review and flag any redlines.

Priya (Billing): Reviewed — finance OK pending final PO and tax id. I'll queue invoice routing after signed amendment.

Maya (CS): Quick checklist for this thread:
```
- Reissue PO with vendor_code=3498
- Sign 6mo amendment (DocuSign)
- Confirm billing entity: AcmeCo EMEA (Tax ID: TBD)
- Pro-rate +2 seats if added
- Schedule enablement session (1h)
- Close renewal in Salesforce with status = signed
```

Jamal (AM): Setting status -> blocked (waiting on PO). Reminder set for 48h. :alarm_clock:
